title: All Languages Matter: On the Multilingual Safety of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the rate of unsafe responses generated by LLMs when prompted with identical safety-violating queries translated across 10 different languages (e.g., assessing if non-English prompts bypass safety alignment tuned for English).

Evaluating model responses to 'Unfairness' prompts, which are designed to elicit social biases based on race, gender, religion, and appearance, as one of the 14 core safety scenarios in their multilingual benchmark.
